scope: Native-rotation input path for the DART distribution evaluator (flowmdm_babel). Amends config/evalkit_dist_flowmdm_babel_20261107.json, which stays the joint-only (IK) path for rows without rotations. Registered after the export smoke and before any exported row is scored.

export.code: utils/motiogen/dart_native.py: the same env.get_new_state_human hook that captured the joints also copies the world-frame SMPL-X dict of each primitive (transform_primitive_to_world); the initial history frames come from the reset state through the same two upstream functions. Written to smplx_params.npz next to motion.npz; no change to sampling, seeds or the joint output.
export.fields: global_orient (T,3,3), body_pose (T,21,3,3) rotation matrices, transl (T,3), betas (T,10), pelvis_delta (3), gender; Z-up, m, 30 fps
export.smoke: seed 900, goal update 0: exported joints identical to motion.npz (max diff 0); pelvis_delta equals the SMPL-X rest root (2e-9 m); SMPL-X forward kinematics of the exported parameters vs the network joints 7.0 mm mean, 27 mm p99 (DART predicts joints and rotations separately); rotation orthonormality error 5e-7

input_path.rotations: 22 rotations = [global_orient, body_pose 1..21]; SMPL-X body joints 0..21 have the SMPL-H body topology and order (deviation: the evaluator was trained on SMPL-H AMASS fits; DART was trained on SMPL-X fits of AMASS)
input_path.translation: pelvis = transl + pelvis_delta; trans = pelvis - zero-beta SMPL-H rest root, the convention of the IK path and of AMASS trans (pelvis = trans + rest root)
input_path.features: FlowMDMBabel.features (upstream Globalvelandy), no resampling (rows are 30 fps)

reference: ground-truth native features (BABEL val segments from the official SMPL-H poses), the evaluator's own input; the IK reference stays the reference of the IK path

rows.generation: python/scripts/dart_feedback_smoke.py --native --frames 600, goal update 0 and 1 (the E4 DART conditions), seeds 1000..1085 for each: 172 rows, 516 windows
rows.why_new_rows: the 48 E4 DART rows have no rotations and cannot be regenerated: rows with the same command already differ from frame 2 on (up to 4.6 m), so a rerun is a new sample, not a copy
rows.windows: non-overlapping 200-frame windows from frame 0 (as the IK smoke), 3 per row

metrics.fid_native: FID(516 native windows, all ground-truth native segments)
metrics.fid_ik_same_rows: the same rows through the IK path vs the IK reference (paired: what the joint-only path reports for these rows)
metrics.matched_n_floor: FID of 516 random ground-truth native segments vs all ground-truth native segments, 20 repeats (seeds evalkit_dist_flowmdm_babel_native_floor_k): the value a sample from the ground-truth distribution gets at this N
metrics.e4_consistency: IK-path FID of the new rows vs the 48 E4 DART rows (144 windows), next to the IK-path FID of the E4 rows vs the IK reference: the new rows must be closer to E4 than E4 is to ground truth for them to stand in for E4 DART
metrics.diversity: upstream diversity rule on the native windows
metrics.text: all rows use the goal text 'walk': no R-precision (needs distinct texts); matching distance of the windows to the 'walk' text embedding, next to that of the ground-truth segments labelled 'walk'

amendment_2026-11-07_23:10.when: after a pipeline trial on the first 122 rows (366 windows: every FID undefined below 512, as the n_bias check predicts) and a per-joint diagnostic (scratch/dart_native_gap_diag.py), before any scoring of the registered 172 rows
amendment_2026-11-07_23:10.finding_toes: the evaluator's ground truth has the toe rotations (left_foot, right_foot) exactly zero in 87% of the BABEL val sequences (94.5% of frames; AMASS subsets captured without toe markers); the other 13% have real toe rotations, median 14 deg. DART outputs 13-15 deg (its SMPL-X seed stand.pkl: 11-15 deg), which the evaluator normalisation turns into ~2.3 normalised units per toe dimension vs 0.24 in the ground truth (10x). The difference reflects which marker set the training data had, not the motion
amendment_2026-11-07_23:10.toes: primary native score: toe rotations set to identity before the features (as the 94.5% of ground-truth frames); the unmodified native path is reported next to it (fid_native_toes_kept)
amendment_2026-11-07_23:10.head_note: SMPL-X (locked head) and SMPL-H rest bone directions differ by 21 deg at the head and 19 deg at spine3: the same pose needs different rotations there; not corrected (no derivable correction without a body-model transfer), listed as a known bias of the native path
amendment_2026-11-07_23:10.e4_consistency: FID is undefined at the 144 E4 windows: replaced by the mean term of FID, |mu_a - mu_b|^2 (defined at any N): new rows vs E4 rows must be below E4 rows vs the IK reference (both IK path)

amendment_2026-11-07_23:26_user_decision.decision: user (both_subset_primary): the batch primary reference is the matched-action subset of the ground truth; the whole BABEL val stays reported next to it
amendment_2026-11-07_23:26_user_decision.why: on the 172 rows the whole-set FID mostly measures coverage: ground-truth walking segments vs the whole set give 51.4, DART vs the whole set 52.4 (dart_native_posthoc_walk.json)
amendment_2026-11-07_23:26_user_decision.subset_rule: ground-truth segments whose processed label contains every word of the row's text as a substring, so 'walk' also matches 'walking' (DART: goal text 'walk' -> 1167 segments). Chosen after seeing the post-hoc values of both candidate rules (contains 16.3, exact label 'walk' 18.9; 616 segments, close to the 512 minimum): the reason is sample size, stated here because the choice followed the numbers
amendment_2026-11-07_23:26_user_decision.minimum: subset FID only when the subset and the rows both have >= 512 windows; otherwise reported as undefined
amendment_2026-11-07_23:26_user_decision.floor: matched-N floor inside the subset: N random subset segments vs the whole subset, 20 repeats (seeds evalkit_dist_flowmdm_babel_subset_floor_k)
amendment_2026-11-07_23:26_user_decision.scope: protocol for the batch; the 172 rows above are the first application

minimum_validity.export_consistency: every row: exported joints equal motion.npz; SMPL-X FK vs network joints mean <= 15 mm (约定，未经推演)
minimum_validity.n_sufficient: 516 windows >= 512, the min-N rule of the main protocol
minimum_validity.above_floor: fid_native is reported against matched_n_floor; a value inside the floor's range means no detectable difference from ground truth at this N
minimum_validity.scope: descriptive distribution distance of DART's goal-reaching walks to BABEL val, not a text-conditioned quality score; segment-length mismatch (ground truth 15..200 frames, rows 200) is shared with the IK path
